── Steers ──────────────────────────────────────

EXIT if 1m closes hold ABOVE 68511 for 15-30m — and exit THERE, not at the stop: SL 68551 sits only 40pt above EMA300, so any reclaim that reaches EMA300 tags SL anyway. Alternative if you want to survive the retest: widen SL to ~68650 (above the reclaim zone; R:R to TP stays ~3.5:1). Pick one — do not leave the stop inside the reclaim zone. age=2 cycles unexecuted.
🟡 [regime] Direction-flavored context for the hold: the 15m aggregate flipped SHORT_BIAS→LONG_BIAS at 00:00 (00:15 = 70 long/1 short/58 neutral) after 5.5h short-biased (peak 104/129 short @21:30); BTC 15m regime NEUTRAL (conf 64). ── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────
The one open trade is structurally right and mechanically exposed. 16902 shorts a tape that has closed below EMA300 for 396 straight 1m bars with 1h linreg still -0.24 — the bear structure is intact. But the stop is the problem: SL 68551 is 40 points above EMA300 68511, and price is now 0.32% below EMA300 with 1m/5m/15m linreg all positive (LEAN_BULL), z-score unwound -2.89 → +0.49, acceleration POSITIVE. The reclaim path runs through our stop before the thesis gets room to work. The standing exit condition (1m hold above 68511 for 15-30m) has NOT fired — 1m never closed above it — so the hold steer stands at age=2; but the human should resolve the SL-inside-the-reclaim-zone conflict now rather than let the market choose.

24h losses — what the winning side looked like: 8 losers, 4 of them counter-trend LONGs (JUP @35.3 -4.72% mfe -0.009 never positive; INJ @55.5 -5.84%; BTC @88 -4.11%; IOTA @37.5 -2.41%, died in 120s with its OWN metadata already saying SHORT_BIAS+BEAR_TREND). Winning side in all four = SHORT or no-trade. Counter-example keeps us honest: MNT SHORT @74 lost -5.31% where the winning side was LONG — so a paired RSI block rule is wrong (24h losers span RSI 21-88, winners average ~31; RSI does not separate). The variable that does separate: momentum-at-entry — the never-armed cohort owns the bleed (7d atr_sl_hit 17T 0W -$1.95 + hard_max_loss 13T 0W -$1.30 + manual_sl_hit 8T 0W -$0.62 = 38T 0W -$3.87) while every winning exit family is armed (profit-monster-trail 30T 29W +$1.56, mfe_exit 6T 6W +$0.27, manual_tp_hit 7T +$0.48).

HL_COPY_TRADING_ENABLED=False remains disabled-by-design (sibling HL_COPY_SIGNAL_* live; answered 2026-10-25, not re-flagged). Live-but-watch-only losers: warrior-sr-confirm+ 4T 1W (flag True), bb-squeeze+ 5T 2W, jup_yolo_mirrored 21T 13W 61.9% -$0.14 (high WR, negative total = oversized losses). The measured-refuted midband steer (meta_rsi 45-64 + below EMA300) is NOT re-issued.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────
1. Resolve BTC SHORT 16902's stop-vs-reclaim conflict this cycle: either execute the exit-on-reclaim condition (1m close > 68511 held 15-30m, before SL) or widen SL to ~68650. Standing condition steer, age=2 cycles.
2. Route the entry-quality pass to brain-auditor: chop-bleed ≥92% all windows, 7d LONG arm tripwire 43.6%, trend-gate source disagreement allowing counter-trend longs (30d 99T -$2.04).
3. No new manual entries while 7d bleed sits at 93.5% — wait for the entry-quality fix.
